description: Static descriptions of buildings b1-b21 for notebooks/full_planner.ipynb. Costs, build times, production and requirements come from spaceinvasion.core.game_data; this file only adds what that catalog lacks. 'name' must match game_data (checked when the notebook loads the file). 'cost_scale_factor' is the nominal cost ratio between consecutive levels.

b1.name: Pig iron mine
b1.primary_effect: Mines Pig iron (+2%/lvl r1); consumes energy

b2.name: Blast furnace
b2.primary_effect: Smelts Pig iron -> Metal at 2:1 loss (NOT boosted by r1); consumes energy

b4.name: Spice mine
b4.primary_effect: Mines Spice on planet-temperature curve (+2%/lvl r1); consumes energy

b6.name: Thermosolar plant
b6.primary_effect: Spice-burning planetary power (+1%/lvl r2); forbidden on normal planets when forbid_planetary_solar=True

b7.name: Development center
b7.primary_effect: Cuts planetary building construction time by 1 / (L + 1); gates b8, b9, b17, b19

b8.name: Research lab
b8.primary_effect: Unlocks & accelerates global research time by 1 / (L + 1)

b9.name: Weapons factory
b9.primary_effect: Unlocks ships/defenses & cuts unit build time by 1 / max(1, L)

b10.name: Fleet base
b10.primary_effect: Grants 1 + L concurrent fleet flight slots & allied fleet support

b11.name: Pig iron warehouse
b11.primary_effect: Pig iron storage capacity 100,000 * 2^L (prevents 5% overflow penalty)

b15.name: Particle cannon
b15.primary_effect: Stores surplus energy to fire remote particle beams at enemy defenses

b16.name: Particle shield
b16.primary_effect: Absorbs incoming Particle cannon beams (46% / 31% / 23% priority split)

b17.name: Microsystem accelerator
b17.primary_effect: Halves all building & shipyard build times each level (0.5^L)

b18.name: Teleporter
b18.primary_effect: Instant zero-flight-time fleet jump between charged Teleporters

b19.name: Galaxy scanner
b19.primary_effect: Asteroid-exclusive sensor scanning enemy fleet flights (5,000 Spice/scan; Escape flights hidden)

b20.name: Tunnel system
b20.primary_effect: Cuts defense dig-in time (60m - 1m/L) & adds L40+ particle fog

b21.name: Quantum Array
b21.primary_effect: Grants +1 Synth Point per level (up to L30, highest planet only)
